notes.title: The story for the Crime faction is now added!
notes.content:
Dear Lost Technology fans,

We've rolled out an update to add the story part for the Crime faction.

The Story of Crime 
The demons who control Dioscurias have maintained their power longer than human history. Having quietly watched events unfold for over 1000 years, the demons show little interest in the conflicts. But what is their true aim...?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/bc61806a17c99d8f522487ef9083692d1a42b9f5.png

Main Characters

Diabolical Demon Director - Demokrishia: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/11175d3908cbfd558300ca4dca813e364141b1d7.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/5f966c08db0fdcd9978bf5293bf03af068cc2edd.png
Queen of the demonic country of Crime, known and feared as the Demon Lord. Reigns over Dioscurias in a castle that floats above a large hole opened in the continent. Hasn't taken part in the great wars, but is always observing them. There is no established system of ranks among the demons, so they often call themselves whatever they like.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/8afaba12c60d689926ec9d8d8493340e3aba616a.png

President - Tuchulcha: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/2ae31168b52e247978043c18f1bbad6ac51865e8.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/114beffdb159ae16960f6925525976dd22cf4406.png
Aide to Demokrishia. A powerful wielder of dark magic, ranked second to Demokrishia in terms of power. Acts as a secretary, assisting Demokrishia in governance, military affairs, and personal matters. The queen's most trusted confidant. While the country stays out of the wars, she amuses Demokrishia in her boredom by researching various peoples and their culture, inviting representatives before the queen in order to display them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/727cc84c641661d73d81224d49a6a310502c41f3.png

notes.title: The story for the Musket faction is now added!
notes.content:
Dear Lost Technology fans,

We've rolled out an update to add the story part for the Musket faction.

The Story of Musket 
An archaeologist discovered weapons known as firearms while excavating a ruin. Intrigued, he planned to use them to win the war and form a technology-based society. But first, he needed to find a way to win the city's democratic election and grasp power.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/abe258c2b51e724ee7729cea2c165d05eb578e7f.png

Main Characters

Archaeologist - Lars: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/aea545c0590fc642bbda2b20655967fc957c6e33.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/d8a925f3086de56a63809d68a77d88f6f87e9594.png

A mercenary and self-proclaimed archaeologist. Makes his money as a mercenary because archaeology doesn't pay well enough. He became interested in the muskets he found in some ruins, and his interests are shooting and reading. He has some skill with languages and is able to read old script. Primarily concerned with finding games and entertainment that have died out. Convinced the ruins tell of a time when there was great peace. He's determined to end the fighting. The type of person to act first and think later. Took on the task of establishing the military organization of Musket.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/b2a05287c26f085fa7fc64189626f8641eef864a.png

Lars' assistant - Crookes: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/105c3b2f501e0d4641d0332ac2de95c640110293.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/987e98c99f7415666e086be77b0fe616f2e36cb3.png

A therianthrope and archaeologist, working to help Lars. Bucking the conventional wisdom that therianthropes have less intelligence than humans she has a keen grasp on several subjects. Able to accept and understand almost anything Lars has to say with an accurate, calculated way of thinking, unlike Lars' friends. Crookes hit it off with Lars when they two first met while exploring the same ruins. Rather introverted, she admires Lars' ability to act without overthinking.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/99a39da756058edabc6d81e057a3ccea8b6a8973.png

notes.title: The story for the Alcatraz faction is now added!
notes.content:
Dear Lost Technology fans,

We've rolled out an update to add the story part for the Alcatraz faction.

The Story of Alcatraz 
The northern land of Electris is known as a penal colony where, in ancient days, criminals were sent into exile. Many of these criminals died in the cold, barren lands, but those who survived built cities and ruled the north. Still known as criminals generations later, they plot constantly to one day retake the more fertile lands to the south.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/997daf35b247ed1ec742618587c42fd120b81aba.png

Main Characters

Boss - Corrado: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/641ab7a615636fb6f4ebb34798e32319d7eed5a0.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/d7398065c7f038b82bba109781e11067e74c6828.png

Protagonist of the Alcatraz story mode. Boss of the Alcatraz organization, which controls the penal colony of Electris. There are no laws on Electris, and though nothing is illegal, robbery, smuggling, prostitution, murder, and other acts strictly controlled elsewhere are practiced freely. However he doesn't touch drugs, and made Ilario promise likewise. Save for extreme cases, leaves the management of the organization to Ilario, the underboss.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/7dc57c037c5263e8c6401de78208ccc176f8a92f.png

Underboss - Ilario: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/9628e4405654876c15e405ab6afc53f38ab154b7.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/8a038d5c26ee74bc07aba2121e1d16908a2cb383.png


Underboss of the Alcatraz organization. Often calls Corrado "Pops", though they're not related. Ancestors were terrorists who are thought to have spread fear throughout entire nations. Within Electris, multiple gangs were fighting among each other, but Ilario managed to corral them together. An arrogant man who believes the strong can treat the weak as they please.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/a8d02359fcfb6716eb5027d93a4da9975cac7745.png

Also, a few bugs are fixed.

notes.title: The story for the Cunitz faction is now added!
notes.content:
Dear Lost Technology fans,

We've rolled out an update to add the story part for the Knights of Cunitz faction.
The translation of the new section has been completed thanks to the cooperation of all the fans.

The Story of Cunitz 
Long ago, upset with how it was being ruled, the knights left the empire and created an independent nation.
Fighting against the oppression and inequities in the empire, they promoted the idea of justice and fundamental rights for all, in the hopes of unifying the nation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/bf03ab234438ff8ed7e8e27d38e9e49c0058ab2e.jpg
Main Characters
Knight Commander: Sigiswald  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/09a7b01590ac3ae7be67a83bae908918151f30c2.png  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/477213e100b3686e554f13704467077e28608350.png

CV: Kohsei Fujimitsu
Commander of a group of knights fighting for justice.
Uses words like justice and chivalry to appeal to the people, but differs from traditional meanings in that he advances human rights.
A lover of books and study, he built a massive library with the country's funds.
Moreover, in an effort to improve the people as they grow, he established several schools in Cecropia.
At first glance, he might seem a high-minded idealist, but he's more than willing to dirty his hands to realize his ideals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/cc0edc414a32c03b93c3cecee753d17eb1669155.jpg

Sub-commander: Philline  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/9c92ec499e842ee2d5167d4471e19bf78255ef19.png  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/03ac3f1468bac939f5039082c71d1c582a1e40ca.png

CV: Haruki Nakamura
Second-in-command of the Knights of Cunitz.
Advises Sigiswald and fights for justice beside him.
Due to rampant discrimination against women, her appointment drew several complaints, but her skills are such that she is able to prove them all wrong.
Serves in excellent capacity as an official, and did much to further the cause of education.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/079d498765ddbb7fc3102f74b407acb09facee98.jpg

Military Commander: Dirk  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/0e2293a46de92a16e04db3ffa4578b249d8824b7.png  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/842433b7751a782d97bd4291808490f6a0a054c1.png

CV: Kenichi Takamoto
General of the Knights of Cunitz' armed forces.
Excelling in military prowess, he commands the cavalry, footsoldiers, navy, mages, archers, and all others.
Takes on dirty jobs in Sigiswald's stead so to maintain his pristine public image as he works to implement democracy.
Friends with Sigiswald from a young age, he has avoided acting as a friend and more as a subordinate as they aim for a just society.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/407834a9679322c854faa0ca88e8bf4176c8972e.jpg

Naval Commander: Arlette  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/f84c59b0f1db44bae7715676e5223f24a4aaeab8.png  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/08aea3c997010e9abf7cd833165ef05271cdbf24.png

CV: Kahori Torino
General of the Knights of Cunitz' naval forces.
Controls the naval forces belonging to the Knights of Cunitz.
While the knights were skilled at combat on land, they suffered on the water.
So Arlette was hired by Sigiswald for a grand sum because of her brave deeds on the Tyuleny Sea.
As a pirate she was quite skilled, but never fought an opponent she couldn't beat.
Though a skilled commander, many worry about her background, personality, and her gender.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/e0a49fdb948a796cff0a23840f2dbcf6c0faea24.jpg

Other update:
Sitri's class changed to a new class "Succubus".
A new class "Succubus" added.
New skills "Energize", "Pheromone" added.

notes.title: The story for the Lion faction is now added!
notes.content:
Dear Lost Technology fans,

We've rolled out an update to add the story part for the Lion faction.

The Story of Lion 
Therianthropes are demi-human whose shapes are between human and beast. They live on Mt. Scandia in Scandia Island.
On the other hand, a ship was wrecked near Scandia Island twenty years ago. That accident made the people immigrated Scandia Island, and then, they built Port City Panchaea.
Therianthropes and human beings had avoided interference each other so there had been no conflict, but about five years ago, Panchaea people made a plan to open up the mountain for the land which would build Scandia Newtown.
Since then, Therianthropes and human beings have conflicted with each other for the land where they have lived.
Human beings killed almost all of the adult male therianthropes who were leading fighters and skinned them to process their pelt into fur which was sold another country.
This action made most of survived adults lose their will to fight, and this enough to abandon their home and family, to run away into continent.
Remaining female, juvenile and old therianthropes who lost their leading fighters, but still put all one's strength in fighting to guard their home, however they couldn't hold any longer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/aed705d70936ffb6a9019334e64418e8ab631baa.jpg

Main Characters

Pack Leader - Shays: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/07b7c96dc173893f22f9e9e758de779caf95ae6d.png   {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/ed6f096e49a25af4c9fcf7a7ef2af8cc63563f88.png

Leader of the pack of therianthropes known as Lion.
As most adult males were killed fighting the humans and many more abandoned their homes and families, the adolescent Shays was chosen as the new pack leader.
Has the trust and respect of the others, but due to his youth, he tends he lags behind his adult peers in political cunning.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/7e3143c85577d41a6a256a119c8876144c4dc9ab.jpg

Earth Mage - Reindeer: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/94415993cf3464400913289bdb9a3d62b771f963.png   {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/b81269a9da51c7077467d1a307f7f0ad6f60dcd6.png

Long-time friend of Shays.
A very calm demeanor, seemingly always in thought.
Assists Shays with the governing of the faction.
Skilled with both earth and crystal magic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/a1bb3728af4b5e72f5b6c5605166d773d423d74d.jpg

Also, a few bugs are fixed, and the skill "Sword defence" is added to Mirka.

Thank you for supporting Lost Technology.

PLAYISM has been working on the localization of this title, however due to the sheer volume of text, it's taking a lot of time and resources to get it done.

The Donation Soundtrack DLC is priced at $9.99, and it contains three unused/remixed tracks by composer Cranky.

Lost Technology - Donation Soundtrack Store page
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1172490/Lost_Technology__Donation_Soundtrack/

Additionally, PLAYISM has completed the localization of the Apoitakara faction - the realm of the Dwarven blacksmiths. The game will be updated with this faction simulatenously with with the release of the Donation Soundtrack DLC.

The Story of Apoitakara
The kingdom of dwarves has their castle carved into Mt. Arsia, where they mine Orichalcum.
The best oresmith in Apoitakara is given the title of "Master", which comes with ultimate authority.
The current Master, Chromium, boasts of making the absolute finest weapons known, and often tests them out in battle himself.

Apoitakara Army
Dwarves are tough and strong fighters, but are slow in movement, and therefore particularly susceptible to attacks from elves and frogs.
Try using the boulders to your advantage to prevent enemy attacks while moving in on your opponents.

Also, the goal for this faction is to defeat the empire - however, jumping straight into this fight is tantamount to suicide. Better go around to all the other various areas first to bulk up your army.

notes.title: Lost Technology – Introducing Dragon Knights of Fevnir
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that Lost Technology is gaining 3 new factions this week! We have already announced the addition of The Kingdom of Gug and Castus to the game, and now we are introducing the last faction before the release of the update.

Lost Technology is a simulation game in which over 100 characters comprising a total of 12 different factions battle to conquer each other’s territories. 

Please note that the game price will increase from $2.99 to $4.99 on April 25th 5pm PDT.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30007316/8701ad8ec638f1807f8fa0e9b1d8a26c59dbb152.jpg

Dragon Knights of Fevnir
Difficulty: ★★★★

200 years ago there was a band of knights who rode dragons through the skies and fought in the name of justice...
However, they and their dragons were driven to the brink of destruction by the machinations of a now defunct nation.
Now their descendants take up arms once again to save the dragons from extinction...


Dragon Knight: Scarlett

A descendant of the dragon knights that perished 200 years ago, and the heir to her family’s dragon.
She wearily watches Smaug, the dragon she has taken care off since she was a girl, grey by the year. She wants to set out on a journey to find a mate for him, but does not want to abandon Bradley to the wastes.
That is, until the day a girl on a dragon-mount of non-Fevnir lineage appears before her.
The girl had set out on a journey of her own to find a mate for her beloved dragon, and word of Fevnir’s descendants had led her to them.
Scarlett’s and the girl’s dragon are both male, making breeding impossible. But Scarlett comes away from the encounter knowing that dragon knights outside of those of Fevnir exist, and she is intent on finding them. Even if means taking over the world to do it.

notes.title: Lost Technology Out Now!
notes.content:
Lost Technology has officially released on Steam! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/420520/Lost_Technology/

The game has launched with three of the factions fully translated. 
Please note that all the factions are available to play, however they won't have any story or events. 

About Lost Technology
Lost Technology is a real-time-strategy (RTS) siege game.The game is centred around three major phases:

Phase One: Turn-Based War Strategy
Recruit units, and build your army. Find those who will fight for you, command their movements and formation to smoothly prepare to assault your enemy’s territories, or being diplomacy to build peaceful and prosperous relations.

Phase Two: Real-Time Battle 
Co-ordinate your army and navigate them through the battle field. With a variety of terrains, attacks and formations, utilize them all to overpower and defeat your enemy.

Phase Three: Story Event
Play through scenarios, each triggered by special events within the game. Your choices and interactions here will affect your strategy and progression.

You must take control of all territories to complete the game.

Comments from the Developer
CB-SXF6:
We’ve finally managed to make our way up to release.
We’ve come quite a long way in the two-plus years since PLAYISM first reached out to us on March 16th, 2015.
Lost Technology is an appropriation of a game program called Vahrenturga.
Vahrenturga was the winner of the 2009 game contest held by the major Japanese free game posting site Freem!, and boasts over 200,000 downloads.
I became obsessed with this game and spent an immeasurable amount of time playing it before subsequently becoming obsessed with creating mods, and then finally using the game system to create my own original title.
That title is Lost Technology.
Therefore, this program wasn’t created by our team, and the cooperation of the creator of the original game “Nanaashi”, was absolutely necessary for us to be able to release Lost Technology overseas.
Nanaashi was extremely happy to hear about our plans for an English version, and I myself was a huge fan of Vahrenturga, so I did everything in my power to ensure that this game could be released.
In Japanese, kanji characters can be utilized to shorten all sorts of texts, but that’s not possible in English.
There are some parts in which the text simply could not be made shorter.
Due to this, we often had issues with the game screen requiring tweaking in order to keep all of the necessary text visible and in place. Each time this occurred, Nanaashi helped immensely by accepting our requests for the required tweaks and adjustments. Furthermore, we also had some very serious problems with differences in non-Japanese OS text encoding, and these problems became so serious at one point that we actually came close to giving up on the release altogether.
However, Nanaashi was somehow able to figure out and solve the source of these problems, allowing us to finally bring the game to release. I honestly cannot thank Nanaashi enough.
To all of our overseas players who enjoy Lost Technology:
I would be enthralled if all of you would check out and play Vahrenturga as well since it's game program can be used freely, so as long as you have the various materials in place, you, too, can make your very own original strategy game on the same game system.

Nanaashi (Vahrenturga Developer):
Congratulations on the release of the English version of Lost Technology.
As the creator of the original, I am truly honored to have Vahrenturga used as the base system for this expansive strategy-simulation title featuring beautiful illustrations, music, and voice work.
Thank you very much.


What faction should I start with?
This is completely up to you. 
We have complied an introduction to the factions on the Playism blog, so feel free to read about Álfheim, Makan and the Reinald Empire.


Lost Technology is 10% off in it's launch sale, so grab it now!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/420520/Lost_Technology/

notes.title: Lost Technology Release Date - August 9th!
notes.content:
Lost Technology will be releasing August 9th! 

Set in a world where advanced technology has been lost due to a constant war between the 12 different factions. Choose your side, and fight on for justice, peace or personal desires to conquer and unite the continent under your rule. This country-oriented strategy RTS is coming soon! 

Add it to your wishlist now to be notified upon its release! 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/420520/Lost_Technology/

Important Information
This is a game has a large amount of story text for each playable faction. Ideally we would like to provide fully localized versions for each respective faction, however, the size and scale of the game meant that a full localization would be extremely difficult to provide all at once, and so only the three factions known as the Reinald Empire, Makan, and Álfheim are included in the English release.

It is possible to start with any of the other playable factions, but story events will not occur and only the simulation part of the game may be played.

The Japanese version still contains the currently available free version, all of the basic functions without changes, and all factions are included in full right off the bat. However, it will be distributed as a paid title due to adjustments made specifically for Steam and the addition of trading cards, etc.

We currently plan to look carefully at how this title sells (including sales within Japan) and will proceed with the localization of the remaining factions in accordance with the sales numbers. The remaining factions are set to be distributed as additional DLC in the future. Please stay tuned for more news regarding further details.
